lines.text: Paul commends Phoebe, a servant of the church in Corinth, and asks the Romans to welcome her and help her.
Paul greets Prisca and Aquila, who risked their lives for him and are thanked by all the Gentile churches.
Paul urges the Romans to turn away from those who create divisions, since they serve their own appetites.
Timothy sends greetings, and Tertius, who wrote down the letter, greets the Romans in the Lord.
Paul praises the only wise God, whose mystery is made known through the prophets' writings, to lead all kings to obedience.
